messages.subject: Bar graph: "Found object is not a stat"
messages.subject_clean: Bar graph: "Found object is not a stat"
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am running into an error when I try to create a very simple plot using a bar geom:
> Error: Found object is not a stat.

The problem seems to be the call being issued:
> ggplot() +
> geom_bar(aes(x = v00_b),data=xh00_s00,stat = 'bar')

I'm no expert with ggplot, but "stat='bar'" doesn't seem to be right and I can't seem to figure out how to change that parameter. Am I doing something incorrectly?

Thanks!

Error in d(eval(parse(text = nm[i]), data, parent.frame())) :

messages.subject: OutOfMemoryError (Java)
messages.body_plain:
Oops,

How do we deal with out of memory errors?
I searched on-line and one suggestion was to use OpenXLS not XL connect, but even though that library is loaded XL Connect  seems to take over.
This Excel sheet only has 327,839 rows

> library(foreign)
> library(XLConnect)
> library(XLConnect)
> Site1_AE1bats_Bats_Freq <- readWorksheet(loadWorkbook('G:/__Peru_Farah/All sites 1-12/Site1_AE1bats_Bats_Freq.xlsx'),sheet=1)
Error: OutOfMemoryError (Java): Java heap space

When I try going to Package Manager I get this results:
> JGR::package.manager()
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: unable to create new native thread
    at java.lang.Thread.start0(Native Method)
    at java.lang.Thread.start(Unknown Source)
    at org.rosuda.JGR.MonitoredEval.run(JGR.java:804)
    at org.rosuda.JGR.JGR.timedEval(JGR.java:250)
    at org.rosuda.JGR.JGR.timedEval(JGR.java:242)
    at org.rosuda.JGR.RController.refreshPackages(RController.java:501)
    at org.rosuda.JGR.JGRPackageManager.refresh(JGRPackageManager.java:221)
    at org.rosuda.JGR.JGRPackageManager.showInstance(JGRPackageManager.java:201)
    at org.rosuda.JRI.Rengine.rniRunMainLoop(Native Method)
    at org.rosuda.JRI.Rengine.run(Rengine.java:640)
>

Tnx for insight in solving this issue.
